bio: I’m cloudy.yang, a transportation engineering undergraduate exploring the intersection of AI, engineering and thoughtful tools. Based in Xiamen and Shanghai.
about:
Tongji University · BEng in Transportation Engineering
2023–2027 · Based in Xiamen & Shanghai
My work brings together Python, large language models, engineering simulation and computer vision.

projects.title: Runway AI: engineering in conversation
projects.summary: A natural-language assistant for airport pavement structural analysis and simulation.
projects.detail:
Project lead for an LLM-based pavement structural-response platform. The workflow covers intent recognition, engineering-parameter extraction, mechanical modeling, scenario inference and result visualization.

I developed the Python backend, agent architecture and prompts, completed model fine-tuning, and worked on frontend integration and debugging.

Outcome: software copyright registration for an LLM-based pavement structural-response simulation system, with first authorship. 

The public repository contains the web interface for engineering Q&A, parameter inversion and 3D-model workflows. The Python backend responsibilities above are documented in my résumé; backend source is not included in this public repository.

projects.title: Seeing better in low light
projects.summary: CycleGAN-based enhancement for low-light UAV inspection imagery.
projects.detail:
Project lead researching image enhancement for low-light UAV inspection. The project quantifies enhancement quality and investigates visual thresholds for airport pavement inspection.

My responsibilities include UAV field data collection, CycleGAN training and iteration, image-quality evaluation and parameter optimization.

This is ongoing research; no numerical performance results are claimed here. 

The public repository is currently an empty placeholder. Research responsibilities are documented in my résumé; code has not yet been published.

projects.title: Autonomous vehicle supervision
projects.summary: A supervision platform connecting vehicle records, test tasks, live status and trajectory playback.
projects.detail:
A React and Spring Boot platform for autonomous-driving test and demonstration areas. The public implementation covers enterprise and vehicle records, test tasks, event handling, device reports and historical trajectories.

Architecture: React / TypeScript, Spring Boot, MySQL, JWT / RBAC and enterprise data isolation, with STOMP / WebSocket updates.

Some statistics, configuration and extended analysis screens use explicitly labeled demo data. This project supervises vehicles; it does not implement autonomous-driving control or perception algorithms.

projects.title: Tongji Parking Brain
projects.summary: A campus parking prototype with record import, occupancy charts and reservation workflows.
projects.detail:
A React / TypeScript interface with separate driver and manager views. It supports importing parking records, calculating hourly occupancy, viewing charts and demonstrating reservation review. It also includes Gemini-assisted chat and report-generation integrations.

Current scope: reservations are held in React memory. Availability forecasts use time-of-day heuristics, while the LSTM training logs and fitted curves are simulated. This is an interaction prototype, not a deployed parking service or a validated trained prediction model.

experience.title: Vehicle Network Diagnostics · AI Test Development Intern
experience.text: Develop Python- and LLM-assisted testing tools for vehicle network diagnostics. Work on test-data cleaning, analysis and visualization, and improve automated testing workflows.

life.title: Music, beyond the screen
life.label: TONGJI CHINESE ORCHESTRA
life.text: A member of the wind section of Tongji University’s Chinese Orchestra since 2023. Performed with the orchestra at the 7th National College Student Art Exhibition and the Shanghai Spring concert. The ensemble received a first prize at the national exhibition and a Yangtze River Delta best-team honor; I received Tongji’s first-class Boya Scholarship. Music is a practice of listening, collaboration and expression.
